children: Thailand's headline consumer price index (THCPI=ECI) rose 2.53% in August from a year earlier, following an annual rise of 1.95% in the previous month, the commerce ministry said on Monday.
The August reading compared with a forecast increase of 2.37% in a Reuters poll, and was inside the central bank's target inflation range of 1% to 3%.
The core CPI (THCPIX=ECI), which excludes volatile energy and fresh food prices, rose 1.44% in August from a year earlier.
